resources.string: Paste a link: YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, X, or any file/page

"Download" opens the quality picker for YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, X and 1000+ video sites, and saves any other link as a file. "Find media" lists every video, image and document on a web page. You can also share a link to this app from any other app.

Downloads wait until you are on an unmetered network.
Files are sorted into Videos, Images, Audio, Documents… sub-folders. Photos and videos also appear in your Gallery.
Removes completed and cancelled entries from the list. Files on the phone are kept.

Smart Downloader 2.0: downloads videos and audio from YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, X and 1000+ sites (powered by the open-source yt-dlp and FFmpeg), plus files and images from any link, with pause/resume, background downloads and an in-app browser.\n\nDownload only content you own or have permission to save, and respect each platform\'s terms. DRM-protected content (e.g. paid streaming services) is not supported.
